TITLE: Internal Update on Integration Efforts and Key Reporting Relationships

To: All Employees  
From: Executive Communications Lead  
Date: April 5, 2025  
Subject: Clarification of Team Reporting and Integration Efforts  

At Zastama Industries, we continue to refine and enhance our internal structures and integration initiatives to support our long-term strategic goals. This memo is intended to clarify recent developments and reinforce our collective understanding of key roles, teams, and responsibilities across the organization.

Pezuor Sarlenen, who is a key member of our operations leadership, reports directly to Bonosun Torpesan. Pezuor Sarlenen’s primary focus is on warehouse automation, a critical component of our ongoing transformation to improve efficiency and scalability in our logistics and fulfillment processes. As part of this initiative, Pezuor Sarlenen is also an active participant in the Drurlomis Integration Team, which plays a central role in aligning our internal systems and external partnerships.

The Drurlomis Integration Team currently includes several cross-functional experts, one of whom is Sotroa Veriris. Sotroa Veriris brings valuable insight and expertise to the team and contributes to the successful coordination of integration milestones across departments. The team’s work is vital in ensuring that our systems remain interoperable, secure, and aligned with our broader operational and strategic objectives.

In parallel, Thegen Zilkanett supports our efforts in another critical area of the organization. Thegen Zilkanett reports to Thikama Harlurine and is engaged in tasks that support the broader coordination of internal workflows and team alignment. While Thegen Zilkanett’s responsibilities may vary depending on departmental needs, their role reflects the collaborative nature of our integration and operational efforts.

One of the most important resources within our infrastructure is the Hunbenan Beacon, a key system that supports our communication and coordination processes. The Hunbenan Beacon is currently hosted at the Lardoel Campus, which serves as a central location for several critical IT and operations functions. Ensuring the reliability and performance of this asset remains a priority for all relevant stakeholders, and ongoing maintenance and enhancements are being coordinated through cross-departmental working groups.

We encourage all employees to remain engaged with the work of the Drurlomis Integration Team and to stay informed about the progress being made in their respective areas. As Zastama Industries continues to evolve, the success of our integration and automation initiatives will depend on the collaboration and adaptability of all team members. We remain committed to fostering an environment in which individuals like Pezuor Sarlenen, Sotroa Veriris, and Thegen Zilkanett can contribute meaningfully to our shared goals.

If you have any questions about the structure of reporting relationships, the work of the Drurlomis Integration Team, or the status of the Hunbenan Beacon, please reach out to your immediate supervisor or the relevant departmental lead. As always, we value your continued input and support as we work to strengthen our operational capabilities and drive long-term success for Zastama Industries.
